about_the_game:
WHAT'S IN THIS DEMO:

  • Time Attack:
    Either 1 Lap, 3 Laps, or Free Run, challenge the timer and try to improve your best time! This is a great way to test the gameplay and car handling.

  • Track Direction:
    You can choose either the classic clockwise mode or the Reverse one. Even if the track is technically the same, navigating it in a different direction means taking every corner at a different speed while also appreciating different elements of the environment.

  • Transmission Selection:
    It can be either automatic or Manual. For manual transmission, you can use the shoulder buttons or the right analog stick (up and down).
    Keep in mind that you can shift gears even when using Automatic mode, if you feel it would benefit your driving experience!

  • Explore: 
    Take a walk around the event area; you might find some nostalgic elements... (COMING SOON!)

  • Settings: 
    Classic option menu where you can tune the graphics features to get the performance you prefer, either pushing for visual fidelity or performance. 






                                                WHAT'S THIS PROJECT ABOUT:

Over Jump is an independent game that pays tribute to arcade racing games from the 1990s. The idea is to recreate one using Unreal Engine 5, refreshing the graphics to today's standards while keeping the same arcade driving experience.

short_description: RALLY! Hot blazing sun! Relive arcade racing with Over Jump Rally – an homage to the arcade racing games from the '90s. Unreal Engine 5-powered stunning graphics, nostalgic music, and intuitive controls bring classic racing to a new generation. Easy, right? Maybe!
